verdict.line: You lose if you throw E into a dash and eat Ki Burst for free; you win if you bait Q or E first and then rip the spirit.

brief.thesis: Riven's entire kit is short-cooldown dashes and a point-blank stun, so she wins exchanges she starts and loses exchanges you start from range. Illaoi's W (Harsh Lesson) is a leap, which closes that gap for her and walks you into Ki Burst; E (Test of Spirit) at 900 range does not, which is why the 53.4% win rate over 382 games exists — it's a kit interaction, not a stat check.

theirWindow.when: W (Ki Burst) up and you're in 260 range
theirWindow.what: She can stun-lock you into a full Q combo and empowered autos. Do not walk into melee range or throw W (Harsh Lesson) to close distance while her Ki Burst is up.

yourWindow.when: her Q (Broken Wings) or E (Valor) just went down
yourWindow.what: She has no gap-close or damage-block for its cooldown window (Q 13s, E 10-6s by rank). Walk up and land E (Test of Spirit) from 900 range, then follow the spirit damage with Q (Tentacle Smash) and W (Harsh Lesson) once she's committed.

boots.why: 73.3% pick rate at 51.4% win; the flat physical damage reduction directly blunts her empowered autos and Q (Broken Wings) spam.

runes.keystoneWhy: 49.3% pick rate at 50% win; sustained HP growth and the proc-on-trade damage out-value her short, spiky dash damage over a full lane.

summoners.why: Exhaust+Flash runs the highest win rate on record at 56.3% over a 36.5% pick share; Exhaust directly cuts the damage and tenacity off her R (Blade of the Exile) all-in.

playing.title: Never W first into Ki Burst
playing.detail: W (Harsh Lesson) is a leap that puts you at point-blank range. If her W (Ki Burst, cooldown 11-7s by rank) is up, she stuns and combos you for free — wait it out.

playing.title: Poke with E, not melee
playing.detail: E (Test of Spirit) reaches 900 range, well outside her 250-275 dash range. Rip the spirit before she's in Q/E distance so you get free echo damage with zero retaliation.

playing.title: Punish dash cooldowns
playing.detail: Q (Broken Wings, 13s) and E (Valor, 10-6s) are her only mobility and damage-block. Track when she uses either one and immediately close with W (Harsh Lesson) during the down window.

playing.title: Save R for the all-in
playing.detail: R (Leap of Faith, 120-70s) spawns a tentacle on hit and deals AoE damage. Hold it until she commits Q into Ki Burst so the tentacle swings land on a stunned target.

playing.title: Track Runic Blade charges
playing.detail: Her passive empowers autos after ability use. If you see her stack a charge, back off one auto before trading so you don't eat the bonus damage.

playing.title: Respect level 6 Blade of the Exile
playing.detail: R (Blade of the Exile, cooldown as low as 10s late) adds AD, range, and a ranged Wind Slash. Play E-only poke the moment she hits 6 until you see the buff expire.

playing.title: Use tentacles to zone resets
playing.detail: Passive tentacles spawn near terrain and swing automatically. Fight near a wall so they chip her during her dash-in, especially after E (Test of Spirit) marks her.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win rates above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the mechanical reasoning — why the leap on W is risky, why E outranges her kit, when to punish dash cooldowns — is my own tactical read, not sourced data.

stats.opponentTip: The victor of the engagement will depend on whether [E] lands successfully or not. We recommend not using abilities first as Riven can easily dodge them through (Q) or (E), but rather using [E] while kiting from a distance.
